source_text: Deus autem spei repleat vos omni gaudio et pace in credendo, ut abundetis in spe in virtute Spiritus sancti. Gloria Christo Iesu in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: But may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope >> Bible:Romans 15:13]]. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
